title.hinglish: Apne current SMB connections list karo

why.en: Shows the shares your PC is connected to and the dialect negotiated for each, matching the NEGOTIATE step.
why.hinglish: Dikhata hai ki aapka PC kaun se shares se connected hai aur har ek ke liye kaun sa dialect negotiate hua, jo NEGOTIATE step se match karta hai.

commands.windows: Get-SmbConnection | Select ServerName, ShareName, Dialect, Encrypted, Signed

expect.en: A table with one row per open share, for example Dialect 3.1.1. It is empty if you have no open shares. smbutil is available on macOS; on Linux try 'smbstatus' on a Samba server you own.
expect.hinglish: Har open share ke liye ek row wali table, jaise Dialect 3.1.1. Agar koi open share nahi hai to khali aayegi. smbutil macOS par milta hai; Linux par apne Samba server par 'smbstatus' try karo.

title.en: Check if SMBv1 is installed on your PC
title.hinglish: Check karo aapke PC par SMBv1 installed hai ya nahi

why.en: Read-only check of the optional SMBv1 Windows feature, the one the worm scenario targets. It should be Disabled.
why.hinglish: Windows ke optional SMBv1 feature ka read-only check, jise worm scenario target karta hai. Ye Disabled hona chahiye.

expect.en: State : Disabled on a modern, healthy PC. This command may need an administrator PowerShell; if it says access denied, just skip it.
expect.hinglish: Modern, healthy PC par State : Disabled. Is command ko administrator PowerShell chahiye ho sakta hai; agar access denied aaye to ise skip kar do.

title.en: See that port 445 is listening on your own machine
title.hinglish: Apni hi machine par dekho port 445 listen kar raha hai

why.en: Test only your own computer. Windows listens on 445 for file sharing.
why.hinglish: Sirf apna computer test karo. Windows file sharing ke liye 445 par listen karta hai.

expect.en: TcpTestSucceeded : True on Windows. On a Mac or Linux PC without file sharing turned on, expect a refused connection; that is normal.
expect.hinglish: Windows par TcpTestSucceeded : True. File sharing on kiye bina Mac ya Linux PC par connection refused aayega; ye normal hai.

title.en: Inspect the SMB2 commands in the capture

why.en: Open the lesson's .pcap in Wireshark to follow NEGOTIATE, SESSION_SETUP, TREE_CONNECT, CREATE, READ and CLOSE.
why.hinglish: Lesson ka .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur NEGOTIATE, SESSION_SETUP, TREE_CONNECT, CREATE, READ aur CLOSE follow karo.

expect.en: One line per SMB2 command. In the encrypted scenario you will see only 'Encrypted SMB3' lines instead, with no command names.
expect.hinglish: Har SMB2 command ki ek line. Encrypted scenario mein uski jagah sirf 'Encrypted SMB3' lines dikhengi, command names nahi.
